messages.subject: r-inla SPDE plot issue (hierarchical data)
parts:
Hello 

I have a problem with the plot display of my SPDE result (attached). There are empty cells in the image plot of the SPDE and I am wondering if it is as a result of an issue in my coding or script. Any help in diagnosing the issue will be greatly appreciated. 

Background of the data: The data contains individual-level sociodemographic and health information of respondents sampled from locations in sub-Saharan Africa. Thus, the individuals are nested in the sample clusters (which is equivalent to census tract in other contexts) and the clusters nested in regions (or states or provinces). Given the absence of a geographic polygon of the census tracts or clusters and the geographic scale of the regions; I tried to capture the random effect using a SPDE model. 

Please find attached the script of the analysis below as well as a plot of the data points (or clusters) and the SPDE-effect:
